pdf_styling.disclaimer_text: This room inspection documents conditions observed during the recorded walk-through only.

guidance.intro_script: Welcome. We will inspect this room in three steps. Move slowly and speak clearly after each Mark this cue.
guidance.outro_script: Room inspection recording complete. Upload to generate your PDF report.

sections.title: Room identification
sections.voice_prompt: Film the room number or name plate, then a wide shot from the doorway. Say Mark this. and state the room ID and type.
sections.on_screen_text: Room ID — show plate, then doorway view

sections.title: Layout & egress
sections.voice_prompt: Walk the perimeter once. Say Mark this. and narrate layout zones and whether the egress path is clear.

sections.title: Conditions & hazards
sections.voice_prompt: Zoom in on damage, spills, or signage issues. Say Mark this. If none, state no issues observed on camera.
sections.on_screen_text: Hazards & conditions — damage or all clear

sections.title: Room identification
sections.default_text: Room identification was documented per technician narration.
sections.writer_instructions: Include room identifier and type when spoken. Neutral tone.

sections.title: Layout and egress
sections.default_text: Layout and egress path documented per narration.
sections.writer_instructions: Describe layout and egress clearly; note any obstructions.

sections.title: Conditions and hazards
sections.default_text: No issues observed unless noted in narration.
sections.writer_instructions: For negative findings use professional language. Include recommendations when hazards narrated.
